description: This file contains instrumentation functions for various web frameworks, HTTP libraries, and databases using OpenTelemetry. It defines methods to instrument FastAPI, Flask, requests, httpx, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, Redis, and placeholders for DB API and OpenAI integrations, primarily for tracing and monitoring purposes.

classes.name: InstrumentedClient
classes.description: Custom subclass of httpx.Client that wraps the send method with tracing instrumentation.

classes.name: InstrumentedAsyncClient
classes.description: Custom subclass of httpx.AsyncClient that wraps the async send method with tracing instrumentation.

methods.name: _decode_body
methods.description: Decodes a body object to UTF-8 string if it is bytes, otherwise returns it as is.

methods.name: _instrument_fastapi
methods.description: Instruments FastAPI applications for tracing, adding hooks for request and response bodies.

methods.name: _instrument_requests
methods.description: Instruments the requests library for tracing HTTP requests and responses.

methods.name: _instrument_httpx
methods.description: Instruments the httpx library for tracing HTTP requests and responses, including custom client classes.

methods.name: _instrument_flask
methods.description: Instruments Flask applications for tracing, adding hooks for request and response data.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlalchemy
methods.description: Instruments SQLAlchemy engine to trace SQL queries, including capturing result data for SELECT statements.

methods.name: _instrument_dbapi
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting generic DB API connections.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlite3
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting sqlite3 database connections.

methods.name: _instrument_redis
methods.description: Instruments Redis client for tracing commands and responses.

methods.name: _instrument_openai
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting OpenAI API calls.

methods.name: apply_instrumentation
methods.description: Main function that applies all available instrumentation hooks for tracing.
